findings.current: “I’m going to take a piss. Happy?”
findings.defect: The draft makes the initial euphemism explicitly vulgar, erasing the register shift when Taekyung subsequently resorts to the more direct 노상 방뇨.
findings.rationale: 소피 is a euphemistic reference to urination; the comedy depends on this restrained excuse failing before Taekyung bluntly claims he will urinate outdoors.

findings.current: Only then did Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin, who had sensed that something was strange, turn their heads in my direction while packing their bags.
findings.defect: The relative clause implies that they had already sensed something strange, and the draft omits that they stopped packing.
findings.rationale: 그제야 governs their realization, while 꾸리다 말고 explicitly says they halted the act of packing before looking over.
findings.replacement: Only then did Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin realize something was off. They stopped packing their bags and turned to look at me.
findings.source: 그제야 이상함을 느낀 궁기방과 혁무진도 행낭을 꾸리다 말고 이쪽으로 고개를 틀었다.

findings.current: “Looking at me won’t help. I don’t know who they are, either. No—not he. I should say they.”
findings.defect: The draft uses a plural subject before Mungyeong corrects himself, destroying the reveal that there is more than one culprit; the subsequent correction is also logically incoherent.
findings.rationale: Mungyeong first refers to one culprit with 놈, then deliberately revises it to the plural 놈들, prompting Taekyung’s question about whether there are two.
findings.replacement: “Looking at me won’t help. I don’t know his identity either. No—I should say their identities, not his.”
findings.source: “그렇게 봐도 소용없다. 나 역시 놈의 정체를 모르니. 아니, 놈이 아니라 놈들이라고 해야겠군.”

findings.current:
“If we have this much information, the Three Fiends might know something. They must have heard who their fellow conspirators are.”

The Three Fiend captured in Sichuan was one of the reasons I was going to the Zhuge Clan.
findings.defect: The draft changes the singular captive Third Fiend into the collective Three Fiends, then uses the ungrammatical title “The Three Fiend.”
findings.rationale: The singular 그놈 and the reference to the individual captured in Sichuan identify the Third Fiend, not all three Qilian Three Fiends.
findings.replacement:
“With this much information, the Third Fiend might know something. He must have heard who his fellow conspirators were.”

The Third Fiend captured in Sichuan was one of the reasons I was going to the Zhuge Clan.
findings.source:
“이 정도 정보면 삼괴(三怪), 그놈이 알 수도 있겠네요. 그래도 한솥밥 먹는 동료들이 누군지는 들어 봤을 테니까요.”

사천에서 생포한 삼괴는 내가 제갈세가로 가는 이유 중 하나다.

findings.current: Unusually, he used a fishing rod made of black bamboo as his signature weapon.
findings.defect: The draft changes the weapon’s stated material from black wood to bamboo.
findings.rationale: 흑목 means black wood; the source contains no reference to bamboo, and the weapon’s unusual construction is evidence in the identification of the suspect.
findings.replacement: Unusually, he used a fishing rod made of black wood as his signature weapon.
findings.source: 특이하게도 흑목으로 만든 낚시대를 독문병기로 사용하며, 친우인 해사방주의 비보에 분노하여 천령폭을 넘은 뒤 자취를 감춘 초절정 고수.

findings.current: The only trace he had left behind was his broken Black Bamboo Fishing Rod.
findings.defect: The draft again changes black wood to bamboo and additionally treats the descriptive phrase as a formal capitalized item name.
findings.rationale: 흑목조간 describes a fishing rod made of black wood; it neither specifies bamboo nor presents a named weapon requiring title capitalization.
findings.replacement: The only trace he had left behind was his broken black-wood fishing rod.
findings.source: 다른 이들과 달리 동정어옹의 시신은 아직까지도 발견되지 않았고, 부러진 흑목조간만이 그가 남긴 유일한 흔적이다.

summary: Six actionable findings: two quantity or identity errors, two unsupported changes to the weapon’s material, one lost euphemistic register shift, and one omitted action with altered timing.
